about: A handgun with a slide (striker-fired like a Glock, hammer-fired like a 1911). What its dossier must hold before modelling, and where reliable data for it is found. Learned on the Glock 17 Gen5 (2026-10-08): the maker publishes everything that matters (spec page, owner's manual with parts list and exploded drawing, patent list, a 360-degree turntable); search engines rank machine-written content farms above it.

closeups.what: the slide's serrations, rear (and front if it has them): count, pitch, angle
the grip's texture and the backstrap: pattern and its pitch
front and rear sights: shape, dots, how they sit in the slide
every marking on slide, frame and barrel: text, place, size
slide stop, magazine catch, take-down lever / slide lock
the muzzle end: slide nose, barrel crown, recoil spring guide
the magazine: floor plate, body, follower

research: 1 the maker's own page for THIS variant (primary): every published size — kit dossier fact ... --quote "<the page's words>" (a script finds the quote in the page)

2 the maker's owner's manual PDF (often on the maker's CDN: check the maker's own pages load from that CDN, then add it to identity.maker_domains): the component parts list with numbers (kit dossier part ... --no N --quote "N <name>"), the exploded drawing, the field-strip order, the technical data table (it lists sibling variants side by side: the variant's numbers, not the family's)

3 the maker's patent list (search '<maker> virtual patent marking'): design patents draw clean orthographic views, utility patents the mechanism — kit refs patent <number>, then add the figures (--kind drawing)
4 the maker's own pictures: product gallery, a 360-degree turntable (one distance, one light: the best measuring pictures — find the frame where the object is widest for each side), press kit

5 the tells: what the maker says is new in this variant against the last one (its 'technology' / 'what's new' page) — kit dossier tell ... --vs <sibling>; confirm each with a second, independent source
6 two or more reference models: kit library find / get / inspect -> kit dossier add --kind model --measure refs/<name>.measure.json (its proportions are checked against the A/B facts)
7 close-ups for every hero feature (the category's close-up list): parts retailers' photos of the slide, frame, sights at high resolution; for a private asset these are measure-only
8 the owner's own photos when the owner has the object (a ruler in the frame): they count as primary
never: forum posts as facts; Wikidata's numbers as the variant's (they are often the family's); pages on machine host names (kit/knowledge/sources.json lists the content farms found so far)
